title: 第八章：斩龙之刃
content_zh:
汉克露出谄媚的笑容，推开办公室的门。
“老大，是我，汉克。”
维尔紧随其后走进办公室，一股淡淡的腥味与荷尔蒙的味道混在一起。
“是汉克吗，算你识相没打扰老子的雅兴，说吧，什么事。”
办公室中坐在一名赤膊上身的壮汉，闪亮的秃头，已经那凶暴的气势，都能让人感觉到壮汉绝不是弱者。
“这是新来的白夜，是‘那位’引荐的，这是引荐信。”
壮汉瞟了苏晓一眼，接过引荐信随意翻看一下，就把信件撕碎，一只手还在身边一位妖艳少妇身上游走。
“当初的价格是二十万贝利，可最近有大事要发生，风声很紧，所以最少四十万贝利。”
苏晓脸上依然满是笑容，他现在还很弱小，所以只能暂时隐藏真正的情绪，虽然他现在很想给壮汉一枪，再问壮汉到底是多少贝利。
直接拿出四十万贝利递到壮汉面前，苏晓一言不发。
苏晓着干脆的作风，让壮汉眉头一挑。
“不愧是‘那边’的人，出手就是大方，以后你就是侍卫队的一员了，记得叫我老大，或者大人。”
苏晓依然在笑，但笑容却透出诡异的感觉。
“好的，老大~。”
加入侍卫队成功，这样一来，他刺杀国王的任务就迈进了一大步。
一旁的汉克低着头，眼睛盯着面前的地面，仿佛地面上有什么精彩的内容。
实际并非如此，汉克在变现一种态度，意思是他并没看到上司受贿。
从这件事就能看出，海贼世界的氛围有多么混乱，只有有钱，或许更高的职位也能买到，但这对苏晓来说无疑是个好消息。
贝利对他意义不大，他现在最缺少的是时间，贝利能解决的问题，都不是问题。
【提示：猎杀者加入侍卫队阵营，剧情发生微小变动，获得世界之源2.1%。】

走出办公室，苏晓领到了侍卫队的标准配置，一身制服，以及一把火绳枪。
仓库中，苏晓有些无语的看着手中那把简陋的火绳枪，目光看向汉克。
“汉克，能不能换一件武器？”
汉克露出为难的表情。
“这~，都是指定的物资，我也……。”
那吞吞吐吐的语气让苏晓明白，面前的家伙在向他索要好处。
不动声色的将两万贝利塞到汉克口袋中，汉克脸上的表情发生变化，满面笑意。
“都是同僚，有难处大家可以商量，武器你自己选吧，但只能选一件，这是谁都改变不了的规矩。”
苏晓放下手中的火绳枪，在仓库中寻找着，这里有各式武器，很快，他的目光锁定在一把长刀上。
刀长约一米多，刃宽三厘米左右，刀身的弧度很小，虽然不及苏晓的配刀，但也是一把不错的武器。
“就它了。”
苏晓拿起刀，将刀归鞘，在他触碰到长刀时，轮回乐园马上出现提示。
“喂，喂，其他武器你可以拿走，这把刀不行。”
汉克脸上的表情冷淡下来，仿佛根本没收过那三万贝利。
“你说什么？”
苏晓手持长刀，偏头看向汉克，眼中冷芒闪动，一味的忍让，只会让其他人感觉到软弱可欺而已。
汉克注意到苏晓的目光后，神色一惊，心中涌现一股凉意。
这家伙杀过人，而且不止一人。
汉克内心挣扎起来，想要和苏晓当场翻脸，当手持利刃的苏晓让汉克非常忌惮。
“汉克，不要在意这些事，我们是‘朋友’，不是吗。”

苏晓手中的刀柄对准汉克的胸口。
要么收钱闭嘴，要么苏晓当场将汉克斩杀，只有这两种选择，因为手中这把长刀，对他完成任务有很大帮助。
而且已经到手的东西，苏晓可不会因为一点威胁就放弃。
苏晓相信，就算他杀了汉克，只要贿赂给那壮汉足够的金钱，对方也是睁一只眼闭一只眼。
“这件事，只有你知我知，这把刀就当是交个朋友。”
汉克亲热的拍着苏晓肩膀，他妥协了，仓库中剑拔弩张的气势消散。
“我今天刚到王都，有一些事需要了解，所以你这朋友我交定了。”
苏晓心中暗叹一声，这只是一名普通侍卫，就这么难应付，等他爬到国王身边后，又会遇到怎样的敌人。
这种充满挑战的感觉，让苏晓的心跳逐渐加快，热血在体内奔涌，他开始喜欢这种感觉。
他体内的好战因子，被逐渐唤醒。
苏晓之所以会这么强硬，也是事出有因，之前在他触碰到长刀时，轮回乐园给出了提示。
【获得斩龙闪】
斩龙闪（白色?稀有）
产地：海贼王，钢铁熔炉铁匠铺
耐久度：35/40-5（此武器曾受到严重破损，耐久度-5。）
攻击力：5~16（根据斩击力强度计算）
装备需求：力量2点可使用，力量超过5点可灵活使用。
评分：10（注：白色装备评分为1到10，评分为10的白色装备，将标注‘稀有’，附加特殊属性。）
附加属性：龙之威严，在持有此武器时，将会对敌人造成震慑效果。（震慑效果，削减敌人气势。）
简介：这曾是斩龙剑豪?龙马年轻时的佩刀，但受过严重破损，恢复后品级下降，后因龙马得到黑刀?秋水，这把兵刃一直陈放在龙马的卧室中，龙马死去后，这把兵刃并不够陪葬龙马的资格，之后流落在外。

主人，我已经快要生锈，你在哪里，请挥舞我斩下那巨龙吧！
价格：1100乐园币（此物品为规则物品，可带出海贼世界）。
龙马可是大有来头，是海贼世界的强者，或许就算现在的世界第一剑豪鹰眼?米霍克，也不一定强过对方。
这种强者年轻时的配刀，怎么可能弱？苏晓甚至怀疑，如果这把【斩龙闪】未曾破损，这或许是一把绿色，甚至于蓝色武器。
这也是为何，苏晓不惜和汉克翻脸也要得到这把刀。
好在双方并没翻脸，这虚假的‘友谊’还能持续一段时间。
“算你小子走运，这把刀是在一伙海贼身上缴获，除我之外，很少有人知道这把刀是珍品，如果不是我不会用刀，而且仓库有死规定，决不能选择第二把武器，这把刀我早就带走。”
苏晓笑了笑，没说话，只是将斩龙闪插在腰间。
有刀在身，他的战斗力大幅度增长，这让他心中安稳一些。
“走了，两天后有大事要发生，到时我们都不能闲着。”
汉克叹了口气，仿佛在担忧什么。
“什么事？提前透漏一下我也有些准备。”
“半个月后，就是世界贵族天龙人来哥亚王国巡查的日子，所以在后天，我们要‘清扫’废品终点站！”
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
Hank showed a flattering smile and pushed open the office door.
"Boss, it's me, Hank."
Veer walked into the office shortly after, and there was a faint fishy smell mixed with the smell of hormones.
"Is it Hank? You're wise enough not to disturb my pleasure. Tell me what's going on."
Sitting in the office is a shirtless strong man with a shiny bald head and a ferocious aura that makes people feel that a strong man is by no means a weakling.
"This is the new Bai Ye, introduced by 'that person', and this is the letter of recommendation."
The strong man glanced at Su Xiao, took the letter of recommendation, looked through it casually, then tore the letter into pieces, while one hand was still wandering around the body of a charming young woman beside him.
"The original price was 200,000 beli, but something big is going to happen recently, and the news is very tight, so it is at least 400,000 beli."
Su Xiao's face was still full of smiles. He was still very weak, so he could only hide his true emotions temporarily, although he wanted to give the strong man a shot and ask the strong man how many Baileys he had.
He took out 400,000 Baileys and handed it to the strong man. Su Xiao said nothing.
Su Xiao's straightforward style made the strong man raise his eyebrows.
"As expected of a person from 'over there', you are generous in taking action. From now on, you will be a member of the guard team. Remember to call me boss, or sir."
Lidya Su was still smiling, but there was a strange feeling in the smile.
"Okay, boss~."
Successfully joining the bodyguard would take a big step forward in his mission to assassinate the king.
Hank on the side lowered his head and stared at the ground in front of him, as if there was something exciting on the ground.
This was not the case. Hank was projecting an attitude that meant he did not see his boss taking bribes.
From this incident, we can see how chaotic the atmosphere in the pirate world is. Only with money can you buy a higher position, but this is undoubtedly good news for Su Xiao.
Bailey means little to him. What he lacks most now is time. The problems Bailey can solve are not problems.
[Tip: The hunter joins the guard camp, the plot changes slightly, and he gains 2.1% of the source of the world. 】
After walking out of the office, Su Xiao received the standard equipment of the guards, a uniform, and a matchlock gun.
In the warehouse, Su Xiao looked at the simple matchlock gun in his hand speechlessly, and looked at Hank.
"Hank, can you change the weapon?"
Hank looked troubled.
"These~ are all designated supplies. I also..."
The hesitant tone made Su Xiao understand that the guy in front of him was asking for benefits from him.
He quietly stuffed 20,000 Baileys into Hank's pocket. The expression on Hank's face changed and he was smiling.
"We are all colleagues. If we have any difficulties, we can discuss them. You can choose the weapon yourself, but you can only choose one. This is a rule that no one can change."
Su Xiao put down the matchlock gun in his hand and searched in the warehouse. There were various weapons here. Soon, his eyes locked on a long knife.
The knife is about one meter long, and the blade is about three centimeters wide. The arc of the blade is very small. Although it is not as good as Su Xiao's knife, it is still a good weapon.
"That's it."
Su Xiao picked up the knife and sheathed it. When he touched the long knife, a prompt appeared in Samsara Paradise.
"Hey, hey, you can take other weapons, but not this knife."
The expression on Hank's face turned cold, as if he had never confiscated the 30,000 Baileys.
"What did you say?"
Su Xiao held a long knife in his hand and turned his head to look at Hank, with a cold light flashing in his eyes. Blindly forbearing would only make others feel weak and easy to bully.
After Hank noticed Lidya Su's gaze, he looked surprised and felt a chill in his heart.
This guy has killed people, and more than one person.
Hank struggled in his heart and wanted to fall out with Su Xiao on the spot. Su Xiao who was holding a sharp knife made Hank very afraid.
"Hank, don't worry about these things, we are 'friends', aren't we?. "
The handle of the knife in Su Xiao's hand was pointed at Hank's chest.
Either take the money and shut up, or Su Xiao kills Hank on the spot. These are the only two options, because the long knife in his hand will be of great help to him in completing the mission.
Moreover, Su Xiao will not give up what she has already obtained just because of the slightest threat.
Su Xiao believed that even if he killed Hank, as long as he bribed the strong man with enough money, the other party would turn a blind eye.
"Only you and I know about this matter. Treat this knife as making a friend. "
Hank patted Su Xiao's shoulder affectionately. He compromised, and the tense atmosphere in the warehouse dissipated.
“I just arrived in the royal capital today and there are some things I need to know, so I’m determined to make you my friend. "
Su Xiao secretly sighed in his heart, this is just an ordinary guard, it is so difficult to deal with, what kind of enemies will he encounter when he crawls to the king's side.
This challenging feeling made Su Xiao's heartbeat gradually speed up and blood surged in his body. He began to like this feeling.
The militant factor in his body was gradually awakened.
There was a reason why Su Xiao was so tough. When he touched the long knife before, Samsara Paradise gave him a hint.
[Get Dragon-Slaying Flash]
Dragon Killing Flash (White? Rare)
Place of Origin: One Piece, Steel Furnace Blacksmith Shop
Durability: 35/40-5 (This weapon has been severely damaged and has a durability of -5.)
Attack power: 5~16 (calculated based on the strength of the slashing force)
Equipment requirements: 2 points of strength can be used, and more than 5 points of strength can be used flexibly.
Rating: 10 (Note: The rating of white equipment is from 1 to 10. White equipment with a rating of 10 will be marked as 'rare' and have special attributes attached.)
Additional attribute: Dragon's majesty, when holding this weapon, it will have a shocking effect on the enemy. (Shocking effect, reducing the enemy's momentum.)
Introduction: This was once the sword of Ryoma, the dragon-slaying swordsman, when he was young. However, it was severely damaged and its grade dropped after recovery. Later, Ryoma obtained the black sword Qiushui. This weapon has been displayed in Ryoma's bedroom. After Ryoma died, this weapon was not qualified to be buried with Ryoma, and he lived outside.
Master, I am almost rusty. Where are you? Please wave me to kill that giant dragon!
Price: 1100 Paradise Coins (this item is a regular item and can be taken out of the Pirate World).
Ryoma has a great background and is a strong man in the pirate world. Maybe even the current world's number one swordsman, Hawkeye Mihawk, is not necessarily stronger than him.
How could this kind of sword that a strong man used when he was young be weak? Su Xiao even suspected that if this [Dragon Flash] was not damaged, it might be a green or even blue weapon.
This is why Su Xiao wanted to get this knife even if she fell out with Hank.
Fortunately, the two parties did not fall out, and this false 'friendship' can last for a while.
"You're lucky, this knife was seized from a group of pirates. Apart from me, few people know that this knife is a treasure. If it weren't for the fact that I don't know how to use a knife, and there are death rules in the warehouse, I can never choose a second weapon. I would have taken this knife away long ago. "
Su Xiao smiled, said nothing, and just inserted the Dragon Slayer Flash into her waist.
With the knife in his body, his combat power increased significantly, which made him feel more at ease.
"Let's go, something big is going to happen in two days, and we won't be able to stay idle then. "
Hank sighed, as if worried about something.
"What's the matter? Let me tell you in advance that I am somewhat prepared. "
"In half a month, it will be the day when the world's nobles, the Celestial Dragons, will come to the Kingdom of Goa for inspection, so the day after tomorrow, we will 'clean' the scrap terminal! "
(Sanqi Chinese et)
